F0_contentDrivenWrap.fix: Re-expressed wrap as an over-cap intrinsic reflow: `.dock-overflow-wrap .dock-layer--full { flex-wrap: wrap }` is ALWAYS-ON (no MQ), and the dock base shrink-wraps to content while `.dock-overflow-wrap` caps that intrinsic width at `max-inline-size: var(--dock-max-inline-size)`. So flex wraps to N rows EXACTLY when the intrinsic row exceeds the cap — at ANY viewport — and collapses to one row when it fits. DELETED the `@media (min-width: 640px)` snap-back + the `--dock-overflow-bp` token + the orphaned `--dock-wrap-max-width`/`--dock-wrap-desktop-*` tokens. `--dock-max-inline-size` is now the ONE cap every overflow strategy reads. ORCHESTRATOR-CORRECTED at integration: the lane first shipped `max-inline-size: min(max-content, var(--dock-max-inline-size))`, which is INVALID CSS — CSS math functions (min/max/clamp) reject the `max-content` intrinsic keyword, so the declaration is invalid-at-computed-value and the property computes to its initial `none`, silently dropping the cap (live: maxIS=none, rowCount=1 at a 1280 viewport with the 28rem demo cap). The valid expression of `min(max-content, cap)` is the base intrinsic shrink-wrap + this plain `max-inline-size` cap. Live-verified rowCount=2 at 448px after the fix.

F1_cardTierShadow.fix: Minted `--shadow-dock-wrap` (= `--shadow-xl` + `--glass-material-rim` + `--glass-under-shadow-vivid`) on the `:root` cascade (consumer-overridable per the cartoon-shadow contract; minted `--glass-material-rim` as the floating-tier rim hairline). The wrap dock box-shadow lifts the three floating-tier layers in via `--dock-wrap-elev = calc(--dock-expand-t * 100%)` — each layer's alpha tracks the SAME `--dock-expand-t` scalar the radius glides on, so the elevation thickens in LOCKSTEP with the corner morph (WWDC25 §219 'material thickens as glass flexes larger'). At collapsed (expand-t 0) only the base `--shadow-dock` glow shows; at expanded (expand-t 1) the full floating stack grounds the multi-row card.

F3_falseGateStrike.resolution: (b) STRIKE — the content-driven reflow is intrinsic flex (no JS min-height morph), so the JS-morph detector path (a) is genuinely unneeded. Struck the false 'morphing (not snapping) wrap reflow' claim from README.md:289 + the prose at :105/:272, removed the `transition: min-height` from the wrap layer rule, and added a real `proof:dock-wrap-content-driven` README gate row.

F4_oneRadiusToken.fix: Unified the wrap shell radius onto `--dock-card-radius` (the SAME density-scaled finite token the big-dock card path uses), morphing pill→card on `--dock-expand-t` (--radius-pill at 0, --dock-card-radius at 1). DELETED the bare 16px `--radius-2xl` literal. One finite-radius source.

F5_horizontalOnly.fix: GlassDock.vue guards the class emit on `overflow === 'wrap' && orientation !== 'vertical'` — wrap is explicitly horizontal-only. A vertical rail grows-to-fit + clamps at `--dock-max-block-size` (its own overflow story). Struck the false vertical-wrap claim from the dock.css comment + the JSDoc.

F6_verticalMaxBlockContract.fix: Wired the vertical max-block-size + internal-scroll contract: at rest a `.vertical.always-expanded:not([data-morphing])` (and `.expanded`) column scrolls its OWN block axis (`overflow-y: auto`, scrollbar-hidden, overscroll contain) when content exceeds `--dock-max-block-size`, cross-axis stays `visible` for focus rings + grown popovers. Consumers set `--dock-max-block-size` per-instance to anchor a viewport-bounded scrollable tool palette without hand-anchoring it (bbnf-buddy ToolsLayer).

F2_liveStory.fix: Added a `overflow="wrap"` section to demo/stories/navigation/dock.vue: a 14-control always-expanded wrap dock (`--dock-max-inline-size: 28rem` host cap so it wraps on-screen at desktop) + a collapsible 12-control wrap dock (`--dock-max-inline-size: 22rem`) showing the collapse↔expand corner+elevation morph in lockstep.

ratifyBeforeImpl.Q1_capDefault: RESOLVED — unified the wrap cap onto `--dock-max-inline-size` (`min(80vw, 64rem)` default, consumer-overridable per-instance) rather than a parallel 100vw-gutter token. The over-cap crossing is the wrap trigger.
ratifyBeforeImpl.Q2_strikeVsDetector: RESOLVED — (b) STRIKE (the gestalt fix removes the JS min-height morph entirely; no spring-driven min-height is retained).
ratifyBeforeImpl.Q3_hasVsContainer: RESOLVED — neither `:has()` nor `@container`. The pill↔card radius+shadow morph keys off `.expanded` × the `--dock-expand-t` scalar (the same axis the big-dock `shape-card` morph rides), because pure CSS cannot count flex rows; a wrap dock IS the card silhouette when expanded and a pill when collapsed. This is the honest CSS-only multi-row primitive and composes with the W01 single clock.
ratifyBeforeImpl.Q4_verticalDefault: RESOLVED — `height:auto` stays the default; `--dock-max-block-size` is the consumer opt-in + the at-rest internal-scroll rule engages only on real over-cap content.
